name: satellite-based-active-fire-detections-nasa-firms-api
title: Satellite-Based Active Fire Detections (NASA FIRMS API)
notes: This IPython notebook downloads fire detections from the NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) API. The user must specify a coordinate bounding box, start date, day range, and satellite source (VIIRS, MODIS, OR LAN

resources.name: Satellite Detections Retrieval - IPython Notebook
resources.description: This links directly to the executable IPython notebook that establishes a connection to the NASA FIRMS API, retrieves satellite detection coordinates and timestamps, and downloads the data as CSV files.

resources.name: Satellite Detections Retrieval - GitHub Repository
resources.description: This links directly to the public GitHub repository where the code is published and used with a wildfire digital twin.

extras.creationMethod: This IPython notebook was designed for the purpose of integrating with a wildfire digital twin in a National Data Platform user workspace. Satellite detection data were retrieved via the NASA FIRMS API (https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/).
